operations.title: World Models: Learning How the World Works
operations.caption: A world model turns experience into an internal simulator: it compresses observations, predicts consequences, and helps choose better actions.
operations.narration: A world model is an internal simulator of the environment. It observes what happens, builds a compact latent state, predicts possible futures, and uses those predictions to plan actions. Then the results feed back into learning.

from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Transformer Architecture", font_size=40, weight=BOLD).move_to([0, 3.52, 0])

        enc_x, dec_x = -2.65, 2.25
        blue, orange, green, purple = BLUE_C, ORANGE, GREEN_C, PURPLE_C

        def box(label, x, y, w=3.25, h=0.52, color=BLUE_C, fs=19):
            rect = RoundedRectangle(
                corner_radius=0.10,
                width=w,
                height=h,
                stroke_color=color,
                stroke_width=2.5,
                fill_color=color,
                fill_opacity=0.16,
            ).move_to([x, y, 0])
            text = Text(label, font_size=fs, color=WHITE).move_to(rect.get_center())
            return VGroup(rect, text)

        def arrow(start, end, color=GREY_B):
            return Arrow(
                start,
                end,
                buff=0.08,
                stroke_width=2.3,
                max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.18,
                color=color,
            )

        enc_head = Text(
            "Encoder",
            font_size=28,
            weight=BOLD,
            color=blue,
        ).move_to([enc_x, 2.95, 0])

        dec_head = Text(
            "Decoder",
            font_size=28,
            weight=BOLD,
            color=orange,
        ).move_to([dec_x, 2.95, 0])

        enc_n = MathTex("N\\times", font_size=25, color=blue).move_to([-0.15, 2.25, 0])
        dec_n = MathTex("N\\times", font_size=25, color=orange).move_to([4.75, 2.25, 0])

        e1 = box("Feed Forward", enc_x, 2.12, color=green, fs=18)
        e2 = box("Add & Norm", enc_x, 1.42, color=purple, fs=18)
        e3 = box("Self-Attention", enc_x, 0.72, color=blue, fs=18)
        e4 = box("Add & Norm", enc_x, 0.02, color=purple, fs=18)
        e5 = box("Input Embeddings", enc_x, -1.00, color=green, fs=18)
        e6 = box("Positional Encoding", enc_x, -1.68, color=purple, fs=17)

        d1 = box("Feed Forward", dec_x, 2.12, color=green, fs=18)
        d2 = box("Add & Norm", dec_x, 1.42, color=purple, fs=18)
        d3 = box(
            "Encoder–Decoder Attention",
            dec_x,
            0.72,
            color=blue,
            fs=15,
        )
        d4 = box("Add & Norm", dec_x, 0.02, color=purple, fs=18)
        d5 = box("Masked Self-Attention", dec_x, -0.68, color=blue, fs=16)
        d6 = box("Output Embeddings", dec_x, -1.55, color=green, fs=18)

        linear = box("Linear", dec_x, -2.42, w=2.0, color=orange, fs=19)
        softmax = box("Softmax", dec_x, -3.10, w=2.0, color=orange, fs=19)
        probs = Text(
            "Output Probabilities",
            font_size=18,
            color=YELLOW,
        ).move_to([dec_x, -3.68, 0])

        flow = VGroup(
            arrow(e1.get_bottom(), e2.get_top()),
            arrow(e2.get_bottom(), e3.get_top()),
            arrow(e3.get_bottom(), e4.get_top()),
            arrow(e4.get_bottom(), e5.get_top()),
            arrow(e5.get_bottom(), e6.get_top()),
            arrow(d1.get_bottom(), d2.get_top()),
            arrow(d2.get_bottom(), d3.get_top()),
            arrow(d3.get_bottom(), d4.get_top()),
            arrow(d4.get_bottom(), d5.get_top()),
            arrow(d5.get_bottom(), d6.get_top()),
            arrow(d6.get_bottom(), linear.get_top()),
            arrow(linear.get_bottom(), softmax.get_top()),
            arrow(softmax.get_bottom(), probs.get_top()),
            CurvedArrow(
                e3.get_right(),
                d3.get_left(),
                angle=-TAU / 8,
                color=YELLOW,
                stroke_width=2.5,
            ),
        )

        residuals = VGroup(
            CurvedArrow(
                e3.get_left() + RIGHT * 0.05,
                e2.get_left() + RIGHT * 0.05,
                angle=TAU / 3,
                color=RED_C,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
            CurvedArrow(
                d5.get_right() - RIGHT * 0.05,
                d4.get_right() - RIGHT * 0.05,
                angle=-TAU / 3,
                color=RED_C,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
        )

        legend = Text(
            "residual connection",
            font_size=16,
            color=RED_C,
        ).move_to([-5.4, -2.95, 0])

        self.play(
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(enc_head),
            FadeIn(dec_head),
            run_time=1.0,
        )

        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                *[
                    FadeIn(part)
                    for part in [
                        e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6,
                        d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6,
                        linear, softmax, probs,
                    ]
                ],
                lag_ratio=0.06,
            ),
            run_time=3.5,
        )

        self.play(
            Create(flow),
            Create(residuals),
            FadeIn(enc_n),
            FadeIn(dec_n),
            FadeIn(legend),
            run_time=3.0,
        )

        self.wait(4.0)
